content:
With only weeks to go before the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Fold, Apple is in intense internal preparation mode. According to a Bloomberg report, Apple will hold a lottery for its U.S. retail employees, with winners sent to California to help staff the iPhone launch event in September.

The iPhone launch event is scheduled for September.

The report says Apple Store retail employees can apply to work at the iPhone launch event, where they will be responsible for "helping organize the queue, checking in attendees, greeting guests, providing directions, and supporting the security team."

Apple announced the lottery in an internal memo today, saying the event will be held in the first half of September.

In the memo, Apple said the company is "thrilled to offer U.S. store team members the opportunity to participate in the event support experience program." For years, Apple has relied on retail employees to help coordinate major product launches. According to the memo, employees who took part in this year's Worldwide Developers Conference or last year's iPhone launch are not eligible for the current program. Interested employees must submit their applications by August 8, with Apple notifying successful applicants on August 17.

Apple has traditionally held its annual iPhone launch in the second week of September. This year, U.S. Labor Day falls on September 7. Bloomberg therefore sees "a slightly higher chance of a Wednesday event, since that would preserve the weekday travel window Apple has historically offered attendees."

If that holds, the iPhone launch will take place on Wednesday, September 9, with pre-orders believed to open that Friday and the device going on sale a week later.
